issues.title: Survivors: make enemy combat, death and rebirth use explicit state

criteria.criterion: Migrate health, status/effects, damage/contact outcomes, dormant and boss respawn, spawn admission, and affected co-op enemy prediction without reconstructing overloaded Body/Motion inputs.
Birth itself constructs clean status and prevents contacts/effects from the previous lifetime carrying over.

Add a concrete birth-transition law, a production-caller integration scenario, and a detected wiring mutant bypassing clean birth or retaining old status; preserve applicable existing proofs and mutants.
Preserve contact identity/order, health display, spawn admission and lifetime reset behavior; update actual read/write contracts and capability controls.

Define an explicit typed death/reward handoff for the pickup ticket. This ticket owns enemy death/birth; the pickup ticket owns subsequent non-XP loot transitions and collection even when currently routed through enemy slots.
Update this slice's native, renderer, co-op, observations and replay consumers together; strict current-stage replay and baseline semantic comparisons pass.

issues.title: Survivors: make player and hostile projectile lifetimes explicit

criteria.criterion: Player and hostile shots use explicit damage, trajectory, age/lifetime, ownership and identity without overloaded health fields or reconstructed Motion.
Preserve allocation, caps, pierce, visited contacts, expiry, ownership, slot reuse and significant hit ordering.
Consume the explicit enemy target/contact and combat contracts; preserve swept hits and hostile-shot damage to players.
Migrate contact planning, co-op forecasts/journal witnesses, current-schema codecs, native/browser presentation and replay consumers together; remove projectile-related legacy interpretations.
Specify projectile snapshot validity and refresh rules; verify lifetime reuse and ownership through existing high-level behavior seams.
Relevant laws, mutants, actual-accessor capability controls, strict current-stage replay and baseline comparisons pass; altered damage is detected.
Do not redesign unrelated transport/prediction, change pool limits or defer this slice's consumer migration to final cleanup.

issues.title: Survivors: make pickup production, collection and rewards explicit

criteria.criterion: XP amount, generation, occupancy and relevant variant/lifecycle data have explicit authority and are never encoded in health fields.
Consume the typed death/reward handoff and preserve placement, accumulation, overflow, admission, collection and slot reuse.
Own gold, healing, chest and relic transitions/collection as well as XP, including non-XP loot currently passing through enemy-slot lifecycle code.
Preserve reward/progression policy and co-op collector/allocation behavior without changing balance, pools or gameplay limits.
Update native/browser rendering, audio and identity observations, co-op, bot/offline consumers and replay for every affected pickup kind in this ticket.
Remove pickup packing/unpacking and legacy field interpretations; narrow access rights to actual operation responsibilities.
Applicable laws/mutants, pickup scenarios, strict current-stage replay and baseline comparisons pass; XP and generation changes are detected.

issues.title: Survivors: remove player/run compatibility projections and declare state authority

criteria.criterion: Identify and remove actual detached compatibility projections, synthetic legacy rule inputs and duplicate writable authority.
Retain legitimate session/run records and scoped observations, including intentional spectator viewpoints; do not delete a view merely because of its name.
Declare authority and permitted consumers for shared session facts versus personal player facts; do not prescribe a redesign of every Run field.
Preserve initialization, movement, damage, progression, offers, reward decisions, revival/death, disconnect, spectator behavior and run completion.
Update affected native, browser, co-op, profile-result and replay consumers; introduce no old-format fallback reader or unrelated persistence rewrite.
Representative public-input solo/co-op journeys, strict current-stage replay and baseline semantic comparisons pass.
Document retained immutable planning views and their validity; do not defer this slice's consumers to final cleanup.

issues.title: Survivors: delete residual legacy contracts and enforce one current schema

criteria.criterion: Remove now-unused overloaded aggregates, packing helpers, fallback readers, obsolete entry points and temporary migration adapters; no permanent compatibility APIs or v2/v3.
All production consumers have already been migrated by their owning slices. This ticket must not absorb deferred consumer migration.
Finish old/new qualification before retiring temporary old-model comparison support; retain provenance and receipts without maintaining the old model as a product feature.
Ordinary replay is strict for the current schema with no migration exclusions; preserve current identity and physical-state validation.
Audit retained snapshots/indexes/candidate lists for source, construction, validity, consumers and invalidation.
Verify directed imports: domain rules independent of ECS/encoders/hosts, encoders consume observations, queries/access visible beside systems, repetitive storage mechanics separate.
Update developer documentation and verify published BendHub reachability after import changes; verify the registry if a concretely necessary package-pin change occurred.
Keep balance, pool sizes, gameplay limits and dependency pin unchanged absent a concrete documented necessity.

issues.title: Survivors: qualify fresh builds and record completion evidence

criteria.criterion: Identify the final source snapshot and provenance; build fresh rather than reusing stale outputs.
Run applicable documented build, ordinary, native, full-run, co-op, geometry and presentation checks; preserve laws, semantic mutants, birth wiring controls and paired capability controls.
Confirm native launch without Node.js and strict replay of the current schema. Do not weaken assertions to achieve passing checks.
Run the bounded paired baseline/candidate performance series chosen in the baseline ticket with matching toolchain, build mode, workload and conditions.
Repeat only to resolve noise, investigate regression or verify its correction; confirmed slowdown blocks completion.
